description:
Anxiety Release Music | Slow Sitar | 1.5 Hours

Let the stress and anxiety go - one long exhale at a time.

This slow sitar music is made for stress and anxiety release: long, unhurried phrases that rise like an inhale and fall like an exhale, so your breathing can follow without counting. 1.5 hours of Raga Bairagi Bhairav over a soft tanpura drone.

▶ Keep going - the full Meditation playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199nvhUBCx5L9ROrDP44H4JzN

Perfect for stress and anxiety release, breathwork, deep relaxation, morning meditation, calming a racing mind before work.
